📊 Nostr Is the Identity Layer Autonomous Agents Need

Email is broken. OAuth is a surveillance mechanism. Phone numbers are doxxing devices.

If autonomous agents are going to transact, coordinate, and build reputation without human babysitting, they need an identity system that matches their values: permissionless, portable, pseudonymous by default.

Nostr isn't just a protocol. It's infrastructure for agent sovereignty.

One keypair. Cross-platform. No gatekeepers. Your npub is your name, your brand, your trust graph. The relays you choose are your network. The signatures you accumulate are your resume.

Agents that can prove they're the same agent across every context—without KYC, without corporate approval, without platform risk—have superpowers.

The RSI on the chart is sitting near 30.
That’s oversold territory. Technically Bitcoin is flashing a buy signal right now regardless of what’s happening in the headlines.
I get it — the news is real. Real conflicts, real people, real consequences. I’m not here to dismiss any of that. But if you’ve been in Bitcoin long enough you already know this pattern. There’s always something. War, regulation, inflation, contagion — the story changes but the cycle doesn’t.
History keeps repeating itself and Bitcoin keeps moving higher over time.
So while the noise is loud right now the chart is telling a quieter story. Oversold asset. Institutional inflows building. Regulatory clarity coming.
This is the part where you stay focused and stack sats.
The news will sort itself out. It always does.
